All four parts (u_brown, u_orange, line_green, inverted_u_yellow) are seated at their respective placement frames within tolerance. The assembly is physically finished, but the run is not clean: pick_u_brown initially grasped the wrong object (u_orange) due to an overshooting authored grasp offset, which I caught via TF verification and corrected by regrasping the real u_brown; and base1 (the fixture) drifted ~19.6mm from its original rest pose, mostly from the recovery actions needed to fix that mistake.
